description: Retrieve passages from the versioned frozen EU legal and official guidance index supplied to this service, with source versions and links. Coverage depends on the deployed index version. For an exact Article or Article N(P) query, include the official document URL; if the requested passage cannot be uniquely located, the tool fails closed rather than substituting a nearby passage. Does not verify law as of today.
name: search_legal_sources
title: Search Official EU Legal Sources
